needed.evidence: The footway is an informal path blocked by stalls and merchandise.
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built, continuous sidewalk on the right side of the street.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and goods completely block the pedestrian area.
needed.suggestion: Relocate market stalls to a designated area to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: The ground surface is uneven and cluttered with debris and stalls.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the pedestrian area on the right side to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: High pedestrian demand due to shops on both sides, but no designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to safely manage the high volume of people crossing the street.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are crossing the road haphazardly between vehicles due to lack of facilities.
needed.suggestion: Implement a signalised or marked crossing to improve pedestrian safety.
